118571.name: Chabad Jewish Center
118571.note: Neighborhood Times (St. Petersburg Times; CrownHeights.info, 6 Jan 2008): 'Five years ago, when Rabbi Alter Korf and his wife, Chaya, agreed to leave family and friends in New York to open southern Pinellas County's first Orthodox Jewish center' (count back: 2003, or late 2002). 'Offering programs initially in their home, they rented space for holiday celebrations. Three years ago they moved to a leased storefront at 6151 Central Ave.' 'A week ago, the organization bought property at 4010 Park St. N'. Now the Chabad Jewish Center of Greater St. Petersburg.

257624.name: Chabad of Venice & North Port
257624.note: Sun Herald (CrownHeights.info, 19 Aug 2005): 'When Rabbi Sholom Schmerling and his wife, Rivka, arrived in North Port four months ago' ... 'then opened the Chabad of Venice and North Port in June'. Herald-Tribune (Sept 2005): 'Until they can raise enough money for a permanent building, the center will be based in their home.' Herald-Tribune (CrownHeights.info, March 2016): 'started ... with a handful of people in their living room in 2005'; land for the campus bought 2012.

384721.name: Chabad of Palm Beach Gardens
384721.note: Its own site: 'Chabad of Palm Beach Gardens was founded on April 30, 2006'. Palm Beach Post (CrownHeights.info, 14 Nov 2012): Rabbi Dovid and Chana Vigler 'started Chabad of Palm Beach Gardens in 2006', 'in their living room'; it 'has outgrown temporary facilities at Timber Trace Elementary School, Downtown at the Gardens and Loehmann's Plaza' and was moving to the former fire station off PGA Boulevard.

earlier.where: Timber Trace Elementary School (services), then Downtown at the Gardens and Loehmann's Plaza

325854.name: Chabad of Pembroke Pines
325854.note: Sun-Sentinel (CrownHeights.info, 6 Oct 2011): 'Andrusier, who's originally from Brooklyn, NY, founded the synagogue in 2005'; in 2011 it was still 'moving from a rented location to a more permanent place'.

371894.name: Chabad of West Pasco
371894.note: Suncoast News (CrownHeights.info, 24 Dec 2013): 'Nearly eight years ago, Rabbi Yossi and Dina Eber started out in a rented three-bedroom house in Trinity, Florida that served as both their home and synagogue. As attendance grew, they rented space in the Trinity Oaks' shopping center; a permanent home in 2013-14. Chabad.org (July 2013): they 'moved to the area more than seven years ago'; co-directors 'since 2006'. A grand opening at 9945 Trinity Blvd. was in 2009.

earlier.where: a rented three-bedroom house in Trinity (home and synagogue)
Trinity Oaks shopping center, 9945 Trinity Blvd.

347029.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Doral
347029.note: Miami Herald (CrownHeights.info, 16 Oct 2006): 'Since their arrival in Doral a year ago, the Brashevitzky family has welcomed ... worshipers for weekly Chabad services held at their home, 5353 NW 109th Ct.'; 'One year ago, he established the Chabad Jewish Center in Doral'. Miami Herald (May 2009): 'Three years later, the congregation ... occupies a two-floor space in a shopping center at 9725 NW 41st St.' (a year later by that count). Now at 10181 NW 58th St.

334256.name: Chabad of Southside
334256.note: CrownHeights.info, 4 Sept 2007: 'Just a short year after first opening its doors, Chabad of Southside in Jacksonville, Florida welcomed a brand new Torah'. Rabbi Shmuel (Shmuli) and Chana Novack. (A 2023 release: 'nearly two decades'.)

312032.name: Chabad of Charlotte County
312032.note: Chabad.org (CrownHeights.info, 4 Oct 2022): 'The very first was also established with a Hurricane—Hurricane Charley in 2004. In that instance, the Jacobsons were new in town' (Charley: 13 Aug 2004). 'After growing out of the in-home Chabad House, the Jacobsons began renting a storefront, where they held services and activities for nine years before purchasing the new 9,500 square foot building', moved in just before Rosh Hashanah 2022: 'the community's third Chabad House building'.

earlier.where: a two-bedroom house (home and Chabad House)

298937.name: Lubavitch Aventura South
298937.note: Miami Herald (CrownHeights.info, 28 July 2011): a congregant 'has been going to Friday night services at Lubavitch Aventura South for three years'; services 'in rented rooms at the Courtyard Marriott' (Rabbi Mendel Rosenfeld). Its first place of its own, a temporary trailer synagogue, opened five days before Rosh Hashanah 2011. Start year not found yet; lead: therebbesimpact.com 2005.

earlier.where: rented rooms at the Aventura Courtyard Marriott

269188.name: Chabad of Deerfield Beach
269188.note: CrownHeights.info, 25 Dec 2007: Temple Beth Israel's building in Deerfield Beach 'will now also proudly serve as the headquarters for Chabad of Deerfield Beach'; 'Rabbi Yossi Goldblatt, the director of Chabad of Deerfield who had already established a strong foothold in the area'. Start year not found yet; lead: therebbesimpact.com 2004.

118666.name: Chabad of West Palm Beach
118666.note: Rabbi Yoel and Chaya Gancz, 2112 North Jog Road. Its site has a '10 Year Anniversary Gala' photo gallery (chabad.org item 4027285, made about 2018, so a start about 2008: lead only). therebbesimpact.com says 2004 (the chabad.org listing is from about 2003-04, perhaps under someone before the Ganczes). No dated source yet.
